title: R'lyeh
wikitext:
'''R'lyeh''' is an [[Other World]] from the [[Arkham Horror]] base set.  It is a sunken city theoretically located deep under the Pacific Ocean, and is ruled by the [[Ancient One]] [[Cthulhu]].
